name: Hailey Park Play Area
description: Cardiff Council play area at Hailey Park, Llandaff North, Cardiff, with separate toddler and junior areas on the council's 2020 list. Outdoor Cardiff describes a playground for children up to about 12; the council lists toddler and junior areas.
